jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Technical Publications
jobs.description:
The INNIO Advantage

INNIO Group is a global distributed energy solutions provider that delivers reliable, flexible, transient, decentralized, modular and efficient power. With a track record of innovation, INNIO designs, manufactures and services high‑performance power systems under its Jenbacher and Waukesha brands. The company delivers power for applications including data centers, microgrids, grid stabilization, industrial energy and gas compression.

INNIO operates a global installed base across approximately 100 countries as of December 31, 2025, supported by a resilient, high‑margin services business that delivers long‑term, recurring revenues across the full equipment lifecycle. As electricity demand accelerates—driven by AI, electrification and grid constraints—INNIO enables scalable, behind‑the‑meter power generation with high efficiency, fast start capability, strong transient performance and fuel flexibility, including hydrogen‑ready solutions. INNIO employs over 5,000 people worldwide and is committed to moving energy forward.

We are seeking a Project Coordinator to support the Technical Publications team within INNIO Engineering PMO & Operations. This role will help plan, coordinate, and track technical publication projects across INNIO Waukesha Gas Engine product lines, working closely with the Lead Project Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure manuals, parts catalogs, service bulletins, and related documentation are delivered on time and to a high standard.

The position will also support the team’s long-term shift from traditional PDF and print documentation to more digital, connected, and interactive technical content solutions.

What You'll Do

Support the Lead Project Manager in coordinating technical publication projects, schedules, deliverables, timelines, action items, and status updates across multiple workstreams.
Assist with gathering project requirements, documenting scope, maintaining project plans, preparing status reports, summaries, and stakeholder or leadership presentations.
Coordinate with engineering, product line, service, and external contractors to support the development, updates, creation, revision, and release of technical publications, including Operation & Maintenance Manuals, Parts Catalogs, Repair & Overhaul Manuals, and Service Bulletins.
Help manage document corrections, updates, addendums, translation requests, change request tracking, internal handoffs, and follow-up activities to support timely completion of deliverables.
Maintain project documentation, meeting notes, issue logs, and action trackers while contributing to Technical Publications process improvement efforts.
Support modernization and digitization initiatives that improve how technical documentation is delivered.

What You’ll Have

Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, Technical Communication, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience in project coordination, technical publications, engineering support, or a related function.
Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured, deadline-driven environment.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and with external partners.
Basic understanding of project management principles and tools, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

What will make you stand out.

Experience supporting technical documentation, engineering, manufacturing, or service-related projects, including exposure to technical publications, document control, content management, or change management processes.
Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, ServiceNow, or MS Project.
Interest in digital documentation solutions, modern content delivery, and the transition from traditional manuals to more user-centered technical content experiences.
Awareness of emerging documentation technologies such as digital thread, interactive service documentation, mobile or tablet-based content delivery, augmented reality, and connected service tools.

Additional Details

Location: Waukesha, WI
Work Schedule: Hybrid model (typically onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).
Travel: Occasional travel may be required (less than 10%).
Visa Sponsorship: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the foreseeable future.

jobs.title: Regulatory Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Summary / Objective:
Develop, implement, and coordinate programs regarding matters of regulatory affairs, as it relates to data management and data integrity, The Regulatory Data Analyst will play a key role in supporting the implementation, management, and ongoing optimization of the new regulatory database/system. The role requires a detail-oriented professional who will learn the system inside out and ensure data integrity, compliance, and efficiency across regulatory processes.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Data Analytics, Environmental Engineering, Industrial Hygiene,
or Toxicology, or related field, plus one (1) year or more related experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Basic knowledge and understanding of regulatory standards, principles, guidelines, and laws
governing the use of chemicals, with respect to various regulatory topics (e.g., TSCA, Prop 65,
REACH, RoHS, etc.).
• Outstanding attention to detail and organizational skills: will effectively lead to the collection of
data for regulatory reporting obligations.
• Ability to research and interpret regulations.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Good interpersonal and negotiation skills.
• Organizational and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple work interruptions and multiple complex projects.
• Ability to work across Japanese American cultural lines.

Competencies:
• Strong analytical skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Ability to extract, query, and manage large volumes of data.
• Knowledge of process improvement and process mapping methodologies.
• Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn new systems.
• Effective communication and documentation skills.
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across IT, compliance and regulatory functions.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
• Ensure the Decatur facilities comply with all regulatory requirements concerning data reporting.
• Support DAI’s EHS department in accordance with the Responsible Care RC-14001 Standard.
• Serve as support to Regulatory Affairs as a resource for customer service and sales for
information concerning Daikin product database and other global chemical inventories.

Physical Demands:
• Capable of lifting fifty pounds
• Have good mobility.
• Ability to work in a potentially stressful environment.

Essential Functions:
• Prompt, regular, and dependable attendance is an essential function of this job.
• Develop and recommend policies, practices, and procedures in the specific area of data
analytics as it relates to global regulatory affairs.
• Develop expert knowledge of the new regulatory system and serve as a subject matter expert
(SME).
• Implement, document, and update regulatory processes, including process mapping.
• Conduct large-scale data management activities, mass uploads/downloads, and bulk data
updates.
• Create, edit, and maintain template for document generation.
• Partner with the IT team to perform database administration tasks, troubleshooting, and support
system enhancements.
• Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, and timely
reporting.
• Provide training and support to end users, ensuring consistent system adoption and effective
use.
• Participate in activities with respect to chemical data input, and help document authoring, and
phrase translations.
• Collect, evaluate, and disseminate pertinent information relating to regulatory and maintain
appropriate reference files.
• Maintain inventory of existing products and their current status with regard to compliance with
federal, state, and local regulatory laws.
• Support Product Stewardship Program specified by Responsible Care RC-14001 standard, to
maintain certification by external audit.
• Participate and aid in setting up and performing audits.
• Complete customer surveys in relation to product stewardship, as required, and implement
proactive corporate policy statements.
• Additional assignments as deemed necessary by management.
